title: Inconsistent `pendingCounts` in `spin()` and `fulfillRandomness()` when 0
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  Inside `spin`, when `totalPending` equals 0, it will set the first active rarity `pendingCounts` to 1.  ```solidity     function spin(uint256 _totalSlots, uint256 _prizeCount) external whenNotPaused returns (uint256) {         // Validate slot configuration         if (_totalSlots == 0 || _prizeCount == 0 || _prizeCount > _totalSlots) {             revert InvalidSlotConfiguration();         }          // Calculate and verify prize distribution         uint256[] memory pendingCounts = new uint256[](maxRarityId + 1);
